sources.entry: Bottle Rocket - Document scanning and management application, compatible with Rocketbook and Scribzee formats. (Source Code) MIT C#/Docker

summary.one_liner: Bottle Rocket Server is a self-hosted document scanning and management application, compatible with Rocketbook and Scribzee formats, according to its awesome-selfhosted listing.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it contains only a title and two headings, "Installation documentation" and "API Reference", with no body text or links filled in. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes the project as a document scanning and management application compatible with Rocketbook and Scribzee formats. The metadata gives the language as C# and the packaging as Docker. Beyond that, the specific features, setup steps and API details could not be confirmed from the README.
notable: Compatible with Rocketbook and Scribzee scan formats (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
Listed under Document Management on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: README is nearly empty; installation and API documentation are linked as headings only and not included
Setup and run instructions could not be verified from the README
